name: ES Futures: Gap-Up Fill Rate — Open Above Previous Day's High
description: Research study on ES E-mini S&P 500 Futures analyzing the historical probability that price returns to touch the previous day's high when the current session opens above it (gap-up above prior day's range). Uses daily bars with LiquidityBased rollover and NoAdjustment to preserve real price levels. Computes fill probability, gap size distributions (filled vs unfilled), and a rolling 252-day fill rate over time.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ES FUTURES: GAP-UP FILL RATE STUDY
# Open above previous day's high — probability of returning to touch it
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# DATA SOURCE
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()

cont = futures_continuation(
    timeframe=1D,
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment,
    i_offset=0
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# PRICE LEVELS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Previous day's high — lagged 1 bar to avoid look-ahead bias
prev_high = cont.h >> 1

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# GAP-UP & FILL CONDITIONS
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Gap-up: today's open strictly above previous day's high
gap_up = cont.o > prev_high

# Fill: on a gap-up day, today's low dips back to or below previous day's high
fill = cont.l <= prev_high

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# FLAGS (1.0 / 0.0 numeric series)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
gap_up_flag  = 1.0 if gap_up else 0.0
fill_flag    = 1.0 if (gap_up and fill) else 0.0

# Sparse fill_rate — only populated on gap-up days
# Mean aggregation over this series = fill probability conditional on gap-up
fill_rate = where(gap_up_flag > 0.5, fill_flag)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# GAP SIZE SERIES (points = open minus prev_high)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# All gap-up days
gap_size = where(gap_up_flag > 0.5, cont.o - prev_high)

# Gap-up days where price subsequently filled
gap_size_filled = where(fill_flag > 0.5, cont.o - prev_high)

# Gap-up days where price never filled
gap_size_unfilled = where((gap_up_flag > 0.5) and (fill_flag < 0.5), cont.o - prev_high)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# ROLLING 252-DAY FILL RATE
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
rolling_fill_sum = sum(period=252)(fill_flag)
rolling_gap_sum  = sum(period=252)(gap_up_flag)
rolling_fill_rate = rolling_fill_sum / rolling_gap_sum

# Total bar count series — used for Sum aggregation in the cards panel
total_count = cont.c * 0.0 + 1.0

# =============================================================================
# REPORTERS
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. SUMMARY CARDS — headline statistics
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title='Gap-Up Fill Rate Summary',
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Total Bars',                  card_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Gap-Up Days',                 card_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Fill Count',                  card_agg=AggregationType.Sum,  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='Fill Probability',            card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Gap Size Filled (pts)',   card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Gap Size Unfilled (pts)', card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='Gap Fill Analysis'
)(total_count, gap_up_flag, fill_flag, fill_rate, gap_size_filled, gap_size_unfilled)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. GAP SIZE HISTOGRAM — distribution of gap sizes on all gap-up days
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
histogram(
    title='Gap Size Distribution — All Gap-Up Days',
    bins=40,
    x_axis_label='Gap Size (pts)',
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    fill_color=Color.Sky,
    fill_opacity=0.75,
    show_analytics=True,
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    category='Gap Fill Analysis'
)(gap_size)

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. ROLLING 252-DAY FILL RATE — indicator pane on price chart
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
timeseries_lines(
    title='Rolling 252-Day Gap Fill Rate',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Fill Rate (252d)', color=Color.Teal)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, title='50%', color=Color.Muted)
    ]),
    category='Gap Fill Analysis'
)(rolling_fill_rate)
